translations.web: “ ‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: Whoever touches the body of the man with a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
translations.asv: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
